plugins.name: accelerate-ai-toolkit
plugins.description: Accelerate AI Toolkit for GitHub Copilot — ask your Accelerate WordPress site what to fix and get a diagnosis, a recommended A/B test, and a verdict on whether it worked. Skills are auto-discovered from skills/; the WordPress connection is auto-loaded from .mcp.json.

skills.name: accelerate-abilities-reference
skills.description: What can this toolkit do? Full list of available capabilities and data queries. Advanced reference for power users.
headings: For the model — full technical reference

skills.name: accelerate-campaigns
skills.description: Which campaign is working? Where are conversions coming from? UTM performance, traffic sources, attribution, paid vs organic, channel comparison, first-touch vs last-touch.

skills.name: accelerate-connect
skills.description: Connect the toolkit to your WordPress site. Set up credentials, generate an application password. Also triggered when the site connection is missing.
headings: Step 2 — Ask for the site URL
Step 5 — Verify the environment and discover the connector URL
The helper gives each request a 5-second connection limit and a 15-second
overall limit. It gives curl the password through standard input, never argv.
Step 7 — Wire the connection for your agent
Step 8 — Restart the agent session (advice differs by agent)
If the user already has credentials

skills.name: accelerate-content-plan
skills.description: What should I write next? Content plan, editorial calendar, topic ideas grounded in real site data. Produces 2-3 upcoming post recommendations or a single brief.
headings: Content plan — [one-line theme, e.g. "filling the landing-page design gap"]

skills.name: accelerate-design
skills.description: Design a new on-brand version of a block or a fresh section — "make me a variant of the hero", "design a new pricing section", "compose an on-brand version", "give me a bolder hero". Produces ready-to-use content; offers to put it in a test but never forces one. NOT for running or tracking an A/B test (use accelerate-test) or a multi-round optimization loop (use accelerate-evolve).
headings: Accelerate — Design an on-brand variant or section

skills.name: accelerate-diagnose
skills.description: Why is this underperforming? Why is bounce rate high? Why did conversions drop? What's wrong with this page? Which page needs the most work? Root-cause diagnosis for content problems.
headings: 🟡 Pricing page — drop vs last month

skills.name: accelerate-evolve
skills.description: Improve a block over multiple rounds — "keep improving my hero", "run an optimization loop on the homepage", or "evolve this section until it stops getting better". Each round fields bold new challengers, tests them, records the outcome, and builds the next round from verified applied content. NOT for a single A/B test (use accelerate-test) or a one-off variant (use accelerate-design).
headings: Accelerate — Evolve a block over rounds

skills.name: accelerate-learn
skills.description: Update what the toolkit has learned about your site from A/B test results. Run periodically to improve future recommendations.
headings: Accelerate -- Update your site's learning journal
Step 2 -- Reconcile the bounded completed history
Patterns that win on your site

skills.name: accelerate-opportunities
skills.description: What should I do first? What changed? Where should I focus this week? Give me a plan. What matters now? Biggest wins. Prioritised next actions for the site.
headings: Rule 0 — Consult the learning journal first
Rule 1 — A landing page with high entries, high bounce, and low conversion is almost always the biggest lever
Rule 2 — A running experiment that's close to a winner is a fast-follow
Rule 3 — A new or spiking source with a high conversion rate is a personalisation opportunity
Rule 4 — A source that's dropped sharply vs last month is worth diagnosing
Rule 5 — Engagement is flat across the board, no spikes, no drops

skills.name: accelerate-optimize-landing-page
skills.description: Improve a landing page. Make it convert better. What should I change on my homepage? Optimise a specific page with data-grounded recommendations and A/B test hand-off. Recommends WHAT to change across a page; NOT for composing a specific new version of one block — use accelerate-design for that.
headings: What to fetch once you know the page
Check for reusable blocks before proposing changes
How to think about the result
🔴 HIGH — Align the headline to search intent
🟡 MEDIUM — Move the CTA above the fold
🟢 LOW — Add a testimonial near the CTA
Offer to run it as an A/B test

skills.name: accelerate-personalize
skills.description: Show different content to different visitors. Personalization, audiences, targeting by referrer, geography, behaviour, or device. Create visitor segments and personalization rules.

skills.name: accelerate-realtime
skills.description: What's happening on the site right now? Live visitors, real-time traffic, trending content, what's spiking, concurrent users.

skills.name: accelerate-review
skills.description: How's my site doing? Weekly or monthly check-in, site health, performance overview, traffic summary, top pages, where we stand. Not for "what should I do next" — that's accelerate-opportunities.
headings: Top of the response: summary card
What you've learned about your site

skills.name: accelerate-status
skills.description: Check whether the Accelerate AI Toolkit is connected to your WordPress site and able to fetch data. Diagnoses the specific failure layer if something is wrong.

skills.name: accelerate-test
skills.description: A/B test lifecycle — plan, create, monitor, review, or end a test. What should I test? Set up a split test. How is my test doing? Is there a winner? Stop or declare a winner. NOT for composing a single on-brand variant without a test (use accelerate-design) or running a multi-round optimization loop (use accelerate-evolve).
headings: "Not enough data" is not "the tool is broken"
Worth-caring-about lift, and the winner's-curse guard
Applied content needs its own check
Recording learnings: losing is the system working

skills.name: accelerate
skills.description: Any question about a WordPress site — analytics, traffic, bounce rate, conversions, A/B tests, landing pages, audiences, personalization, campaigns, content performance, what to improve, how the site is doing. Routes to the right workflow.
headings: What you can do for the user
1. Audience signal priority (for personalisation and targeting)
